GeoNames geographical data attribution

This product includes geographical data from GeoNames:
https://www.geonames.org/

The source dump is available from:
https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/

GeoNames data is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
International License:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The generated website asset contains the GeoNames cities15000 dataset
(cities with a population over 15,000 or capitals) except mainland China,
which continues to use the site's existing official Chinese city catalog.
